title: Workflows and agents: who owns the control flow

items.stem: What mainly separates a workflow from an agent?

options.text: How large the model is and how many tools it may call
Whether code or the model decides each next step at run time
Whether a request makes more than one call to the model
Whether the final answer must follow a fixed output format

items.stem: Your assistant's code always runs these steps. (1) A model call labels the student's question "booking" or "manual". (2) The code runs check_calendar for a booking label, or search_manuals for a manual label. (3) A second model call writes the reply from the tool's result. Who owns the control flow here?

options.text: The model, because it calls tools and writes the final reply
The model, because it chooses between two different tools
The code, because the steps and branches are fixed in advance
The student, because the question they type picks the branch

items.stem: Which part of the makerspace assistant is the best candidate for a fixed workflow rather than an agent?

options.text: Booking a slot: check training, check calendar, reserve, then confirm, in that order every time
Answering a vague question that may need several manuals and some follow-up searches
Working out why a machine failed from a student's rambling description of symptoms
Comparing two manuals that disagree about a setting and deciding which one to trust

items.stem: In a workflow, what decides which step runs next? Answer in a few words.
For one sub-task, which is the strongest reason to choose an agent over a fixed workflow?

options.text: It will cost less per request than a fixed sequence of calls
It removes the need for a step limit or other stopping rule
It makes the behavior more predictable and easier to test
The steps needed cannot be known before seeing the request

items.stem: Your sponsor's model budget is $12.00. Treat every model call as costing $0.02. A fixed workflow for answering a manual question always makes exactly 3 model calls. How many manual questions can the workflow answer before the budget is used up?
